source: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, 2026 statutory corporate income tax rates, combined including local where applicable
notes: Annual source; refresh due January 2027 alongside the ERP table.

Uruguay added 2026-09-23 (55) from PwC's Worldwide Tax Summaries: the corporate income tax rate on net income from business activities is 25%, and the summary states that no taxes on corporate income may be levied by municipal or other local authorities, so the combined-including-local figure the file records is the same 25%.

Denmark added 2026-09-24 (65): PwC's Worldwide Tax Summaries gives a corporate income tax rate of 22%, and its local income taxes section reads in full that there is no local corporate income tax or similar surcharge, so the combined-including-local figure this file records is the same 22%.

Mexico added 2026-09-29 (71): PwC's Worldwide Tax Summaries gives a federal corporate income tax rate of 30%, and its local income taxes section states that there are no state taxes on corporate net income, so the combined-including-local figure this file records is the same 30%.
